verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust server-rendered web framework and UI component toolkit, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools is an MCP-client capability outside this product's category, and nothing in the evidence shows Proa ships any MCP client feature. Its agent-facing items (AGENTS.md scaffolding, Markdown docs, llms-full.txt) serve docs to agents and do not consume MCP tools.
